summary: Iteration 30 - Hybrid Privacy Model (Plan C) Testing. Backend: 21/21 tests passed (100%). Frontend: Privacy Settings page now loads correctly after fixing Expo Router route conflict. Fixed missing default_privacy field in User model.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: User model in backend/models/all.py was missing default_privacy field. Added 'default_privacy: str = "public"' to the model

FIXED: Frontend route conflict - settings.tsx was at /app/frontend/app/settings.tsx which conflicted with /app/frontend/app/settings/ directory. Moved to /app/frontend/app/settings/index.tsx and updated imports to use ../../ instead of ../

success_rate.frontend: 100% - Privacy page loads, all options visible

context_for_next_testing_agent: Hybrid Privacy Model (Plan C) fully implemented and tested. Backend User model now has default_privacy field. Frontend route conflict fixed by moving settings.tsx to settings/index.tsx. Privacy settings page at /settings/privacy shows three options (Public, Friends Only, Private) with explanations for per-visit override and leaderboard impact. All backend APIs working: POST /api/visits with visibility, PUT /api/visits/{visit_id}/privacy, PUT /api/auth/privacy with retroactive update counts, GET /api/auth/me with default_privacy.

POST /api/visits.notes: Accepts optional visibility field, falls back to user default_privacy when not provided

PUT /api/visits/{visit_id}/privacy.notes: Changes visibility of a specific visit, also updates associated activity

PUT /api/auth/privacy.notes: Changes default privacy, returns updated_visits and updated_activities counts

AddVisitModal visibility selector.notes: VISIBILITY_OPTIONS constant with public/friends/private, visibility state, handleSubmit sends visibility

visit-detail visibility section.notes: VISIBILITY_META, handleChangeVisibility function, visibility UI section with change capability

settings/privacy.tsx page.notes: Dedicated privacy settings page loads correctly, shows three privacy options with descriptions, per-visit override explanation, and leaderboard impact explanation

settings.tsx privacy link.notes: Settings page has privacy section linking to /settings/privacy

bugs_fixed.issue: User model missing default_privacy field causing POST /api/visits to fail with 500 error
bugs_fixed.root_cause: The User Pydantic model in backend/models/all.py did not have the default_privacy field, but the code in visits.py was accessing current_user.default_privacy
bugs_fixed.fix: Added 'default_privacy: str = "public"' to the User model class

bugs_fixed.root_cause: Expo Router route conflict - settings.tsx file at root level conflicted with settings/ directory containing privacy.tsx
bugs_fixed.fix: Moved /app/frontend/app/settings.tsx to /app/frontend/app/settings/index.tsx and updated all relative imports from ../ to ../../
